description: This file implements serialization and string conversion utilities, including functions for converting between wide and narrow strings, hex encoding/decoding, base64 encoding, and escaping strings, within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

methods.name: ToString(const wchar_t[], std::string&)
methods.description: Converts a wide-character string to a standard string.

methods.name: ToString(const char[], std::wstring&)
methods.description: Converts a narrow-character string to a wide string.

methods.name: ToString(const wchar_t[], unsigned int)
methods.description: Converts a wide-character string to a standard string, considering length, with conditional Unicode support.

methods.name: ToString(const char[], unsigned int)
methods.description: Converts a character array to a string, with Unicode considerations.

methods.name: ToHexString(const uint8_t[], const uint16_t, string&)
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: FromHexString(const string&, uint8_t*, const uint16_t)
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a byte array.

methods.name: ToString(const uint8_t[], const uint16_t, const bool, string&)
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a base64 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString(const string&, uint8_t[], uint16_t&, const TCHAR*)
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into a byte array.

methods.name: ToQuotedString(const TCHAR, const string&)
methods.description: Escapes internal quotes in a string and wraps it with quotes.
